knightOrders.name: Sir Vance of the Roll
knightOrders.title: Order I — Sir Vance of the Roll (Precinct & Registration Recon)
knightOrders.motto: VERIFY THE ROLL // LOCK THE PRECINCT
knightOrders.armorNotes: Hounskull bascinet helm with articulated bevors, fluted reconnaissance pauldrons, and illuminated precinct scroll.
knightOrders.armorDescription: Hounskull bascinet helm with articulated bevors, fluted reconnaissance pauldrons, and illuminated precinct scroll.
knightOrders.civicMission: Verify active voter registration, confirm assigned November 3 polling place, and inspect precinct opening hours.
knightOrders.civicRole: Verify active voter registration, confirm assigned November 3 polling place, and inspect precinct opening hours.

knightOrders.name: Dame Astraea of the Warrant

knightOrders.motto: WEIGH THE MEASURE // WIELD THE WARRANT

knightOrders.armorDescription: Gothic Milanese plate cuirass with balanced civic scales and twin-fullered broadsword of equilibrium.
knightOrders.civicMission: Contemplate nonpartisan sample ballot offices and civic propositions, locking deliberate choices prior to entering the booth.
knightOrders.civicRole: Contemplate nonpartisan sample ballot offices and civic propositions, locking deliberate choices prior to entering the booth.

knightOrders.armorDescription: Heavy siege great-helm and fortress pavise tower shield engraved with the statutory In-Line Voting Right Mandate.
knightOrders.civicMission: Stand fast in queue before poll closing and uphold statutory voter rights, provisional ballot rules, and hotline access.
knightOrders.civicRole: Stand fast in queue before poll closing and uphold statutory voter rights, provisional ballot rules, and hotline access.

readinessGauntlet.title: Verify Registration & Precinct Location
readinessGauntlet.tacticalObjective: Confirm active registration status and exact precinct polling address for Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
readinessGauntlet.description: Confirm active registration status and exact precinct polling address for Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
readinessGauntlet.instructions: Check official state/local election roll lookup and note precinct room number.
readinessGauntlet.actionHint: Check official state/local election roll lookup and note precinct room number.

readinessGauntlet.title: Confirm Accepted Voter ID & Provisional Ballot Rights
readinessGauntlet.tacticalObjective: Pack required or backup voter identification and know your statutory right to cast a provisional ballot if challenged.
readinessGauntlet.description: Pack required or backup voter identification and know your statutory right to cast a provisional ballot if challenged.
readinessGauntlet.instructions: Verify state ID rules and remember: never leave a polling place without casting a regular or provisional ballot.
readinessGauntlet.actionHint: Verify state ID rules and remember: never leave a polling place without casting a regular or provisional ballot.

readinessGauntlet.title: Lock Sample Ballot & Proposition Choices

readinessGauntlet.description: Review all 6 sample ballot offices and civic propositions below so you enter the voting booth prepared.
readinessGauntlet.instructions: Use the Sample Ballot Simulator below to lock your selections and export or print your reference sheet.
readinessGauntlet.actionHint: Use the Sample Ballot Simulator below to lock your selections and export or print your reference sheet.

readinessGauntlet.title: Plan Transit & Poll-Closing Buffer Window
readinessGauntlet.tacticalObjective: Schedule arrival well before local poll close and commit the In-Line Voting Right Mandate to memory.
readinessGauntlet.description: Schedule arrival well before local poll close and commit the In-Line Voting Right Mandate to memory.
readinessGauntlet.instructions: Arrive prior to local poll close; if queued before closing time, stay in line—your right to vote is protected by law.

sampleBallotContests.title: United States Representative — Congressional District
sampleBallotContests.summary: Two-year federal legislative mandate representing district constituents in the U.S. House of Representatives.
sampleBallotContests.plainLanguageSummary: Two-year federal legislative mandate representing district constituents in the U.S. House of Representatives.
sampleBallotContests.fiscalImpact: Direct oversight of federal appropriations, infrastructure grants, and civic technology standards.
sampleBallotContests.pros: Candidate A emphasizes local transit modernization and election security grants.
sampleBallotContests.cons: Candidate B prioritizes regulatory streamlining and municipal tax relief.

sampleBallotContests.title: Governor & Statewide Constitutional Officers
sampleBallotContests.summary: Four-year state executive mandate overseeing state agencies, emergency readiness, and statutory administration.
sampleBallotContests.plainLanguageSummary: Four-year state executive mandate overseeing state agencies, emergency readiness, and statutory administration.
sampleBallotContests.fiscalImpact: Shapes the biennial state budget, education funding formulas, and statewide infrastructure bonds.
sampleBallotContests.pros: Candidate A proposes expanded public school endowments and regional rail corridors.
sampleBallotContests.cons: Candidate B proposes small-business tax credits and expedited permitting.

sampleBallotContests.title: Municipal Charter Amendment — Independent Redistricting & Ethics Commission
sampleBallotContests.summary: Establishes an 11-member nonpartisan citizen commission to draw municipal ward boundaries and audit public contracts.
sampleBallotContests.plainLanguageSummary: Establishes an 11-member nonpartisan citizen commission to draw municipal ward boundaries and audit public contracts.
sampleBallotContests.fiscalImpact: Estimated $1.2M annual administrative allocation (0.04% of municipal general fund).
sampleBallotContests.pros: FOR removes partisan conflict of interest from ward boundary drawing and strengthens open-records enforcement.
sampleBallotContests.cons: AGAINST argues elected council members should retain direct accountability over redistricting.

sampleBallotContests.title: Clean Water, Grid Resilience & Transit Modernization Bond
sampleBallotContests.summary: Authorizes $450M in general obligation bonds to replace lead water mains, harden microgrids, and expand electric bus fleets.
sampleBallotContests.plainLanguageSummary: Authorizes $450M in general obligation bonds to replace lead water mains, harden microgrids, and expand electric bus fleets.
sampleBallotContests.fiscalImpact: Financed over 25 years via existing debt-service millage without raising baseline residential property tax rates.
sampleBallotContests.pros: FOR accelerates critical water pipe replacement and unlocks 2:1 federal matching funds.
sampleBallotContests.cons: AGAINST cautions against long-term municipal bond obligations during higher interest cycles.

sampleBallotContests.title: Digital Privacy & Public Algorithmic Transparency Initiative
sampleBallotContests.summary: Requires municipal agencies to publish open-source algorithmic impact assessments and prohibits warrantless biometric surveillance.
sampleBallotContests.plainLanguageSummary: Requires municipal agencies to publish open-source algorithmic impact assessments and prohibits warrantless biometric surveillance.
sampleBallotContests.fiscalImpact: Minimal net fiscal cost ($350K annual audit compliance offset by software procurement savings).
sampleBallotContests.pros: FOR protects resident data privacy and ensures public auditability of automated civic decision systems.
sampleBallotContests.cons: AGAINST raises concerns about additional procurement review steps for vendor software.

sampleBallotContests.title: Public School & Evening Library Civic Access Renewal Levy
sampleBallotContests.summary: Renews an existing 8-year local levy funding universal after-school STEM labs and 7-day neighborhood library hours.
sampleBallotContests.plainLanguageSummary: Renews an existing 8-year local levy funding universal after-school STEM labs and 7-day neighborhood library hours.
sampleBallotContests.fiscalImpact: Renews existing $18 per $100,000 assessed valuation levy with no increase over current tax bills.
sampleBallotContests.pros: FOR preserves evening library hours, free community broadband terminals, and youth maker labs.
sampleBallotContests.cons: AGAINST favors sunsetting dedicated levies in favor of general-fund budget appropriations.

voterRightsAndHotlines.inLineMandateHeadline: STAY IN LINE IF QUEUED BEFORE POLL CLOSE ON NOVEMBER 3
voterRightsAndHotlines.inLineMandateDetail: If you are in line before polls close on November 3, stay in line—your right to cast a ballot is protected by law.

rights.title: Right to Stay in Line Before Poll Close
rights.statuteSummary: Any eligible voter standing in the polling place queue at the scheduled closing time on November 3 must be permitted to vote.
rights.description: Any eligible voter standing in the polling place queue at the scheduled closing time on November 3 must be permitted to vote.

rights.title: Right to a Replacement Ballot if Spoiled
rights.statuteSummary: If you make a mistake or tear your paper ballot before casting it, you have the right to request a fresh replacement ballot from poll workers.
rights.description: If you make a mistake or tear your paper ballot before casting it, you have the right to request a fresh replacement ballot from poll workers.

rights.title: Right to Cast a Provisional Ballot
rights.statuteSummary: If your name is missing from the precinct roll or your ID is challenged, demand a provisional ballot so your eligibility can be verified and counted.
rights.description: If your name is missing from the precinct roll or your ID is challenged, demand a provisional ballot so your eligibility can be verified and counted.

rights.title: Right to Accessible Voting Machines & Assistance
rights.statuteSummary: Every polling place must provide an operational accessible voting system and permit voter-chosen assistance (excluding the voter's employer or union agent).
rights.description: Every polling place must provide an operational accessible voting system and permit voter-chosen assistance (excluding the voter's employer or union agent).
